```sql
SELECT
  district,
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100.0) -
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_completed ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100.0) AS percentage_point_change
FROM anc_visits
WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)
GROUP BY district;
```
